queries.prompt: Validate whether Amazon Bedrock AgentCore observability, CloudWatch Transaction Search, and X-Ray span delivery are configured properly in ap-south-1.
Set up OpenTelemetry (ADOT) tracing, logs, and session metrics for our AgentCore Runtime and Memory resources.
Run an AgentCore observability readiness check across our Runtime, Gateway, and Lambda-hosted agents.
Why can't I see any spans in CloudWatch GenAI Observability even though my AgentCore agent is handling requests and writing runtime logs?
What OTEL environment variables and Lambda Layer settings do we need so an external Strands agent running on AWS Lambda and ECS reports traces to CloudWatch?
Check if our `/aws/bedrock-agentcore/runtimes/` log group has the required `xray.amazonaws.com` resource policy for unified span delivery.
Before next week's launch, SRE wants proof that our new AgentCore runtime (`orders_agent`) and its Code Interpreter built-in tool will emit end-to-end traces and vended logs into CloudWatch.
We migrated our agent to an August 2026 AgentCore runtime with `aws-opentelemetry-distro==0.14.0` and `UNIFIED_TRACES_DESTINATION_ENABLED=true`, and spans aren't landing in the agent's log group.

Our security team only granted basic `logs:DescribeLogGroups` and `cloudwatch:ListMetrics` permissions — tell us what AgentCore telemetry wiring you can verify right now vs what inline read-only IAM policy unlocks full Transaction Search checks.
Investigate why our LLM eval scores dropped in Arize AX after yesterday's prompt version label change using Arize monitors and OpenInference spans.
Configure `Builtin.GoalSuccessRate` and custom code-based AgentCore Evaluators with a CI/CD quality gate in our `agentcore.json` project.
Audit our Bedrock foundation-model Zero Data Retention (ZDR) regimes, 5:1 Claude output token TPM burndown, and Organization SCPs before production cutover.
